concept: Recognizing when someone else's idea or approach is genuinely better than your own
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is in a group setting where someone else proposes an approach genuinely better than the student's own idea
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether to advocate for their own idea anyway or support the better one
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made it hard or easy to support someone else's idea

assessment.success_marker: student can articulate genuinely why the other idea was better, not just concede without understanding why
